user.title: Connect to AECC Battery
user.description: Enter the local network details for your AECC-platform battery. The battery must be reachable at the given IP before you can continue.

data_description.host: Static local IP of your battery (e.g. 192.168.0.100)
data_description.port: TCP port the battery listens on (typically 8080)
data_description.name: Friendly name shown in Home Assistant
data_description.model: Model name (e.g. Hub 2400 AC, S2400, SR)

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect - check the IP, port, and that the battery is online.
error.unknown: Unexpected error - see the Home Assistant log for details.

init.title: Reconfigure AECC Battery
init.description: Update the connection details. Home Assistant will reconnect immediately.

data_description.max_charge_power: Highest charging power the integration will command (100-2400W, default 800W). Charging draws from the grid, so feed-in limits do not apply.
data_description.max_discharge_power: Highest discharging power the integration will command (100-2400W, default 800W). For output above 800W the device's own 'On Grid Output' setting in the vendor app must also be raised.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect - check the IP, port, and that the battery is online.
error.unknown: Unexpected error - see the Home Assistant log for details.
